page.overview:
Who is Bertha Butterswagon?

Betha Butterswagon is a minor character in Cars. She is a green Remirunabout MenV. She is a calm vehicle who works as a license plate frame maker.

"Bertha Butterswagon has made a mint off her custom line of license plate frames, each one hand painted with little teddy cars. They've swept the nation and can be found in auto part stores everywhere. Who knew a homemade holiday gift for her sister would become such a hit?"

Bertha calmly drives alongside Mack. She notices that he is making faces behind a tank truck, and gets confused about what the semitruck is doing.
